definitions.explanation: The amount that can be held in one hand when gripped. A physical quantity measurement.

definitions.gloss: a small number; a select few; a tiny minority
definitions.explanation: Figuratively, a very small number of people or things out of a larger group. Emphasizes how few they are.

examples.japanese: ⟦{砂|すな}→砂：00890_suna⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{一握|ひとにぎ}りつかんだ。
examples.english: I grabbed a handful of sand.

examples.japanese: ⟦{塩|しお}→塩：00887_shio⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{一握|ひとにぎ}り⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
⟦{米|こめ}→米：01323_kome⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{一握|ひとにぎ}り⟦{鍋|なべ}→鍋：01038_nabe⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{加|くわ}えた→加える：01941_kuwaeru⟧。
examples.english: I added a handful of rice to the pot.

examples.japanese: ⟦{成功|せいこう}する→成功する：21445_seikousuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一握|ひとにぎ}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧だ。
examples.english: Only a handful of people succeed.

examples.japanese: {一握|ひとにぎ}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{富裕層|ふゆうそう}→富裕層：12390_fuyuusou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{富|とみ}→富：12321_tomi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{独占|どくせん}→独占：13494_dokusen⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A tiny minority of wealthy people monopolize the wealth.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合格|ごうかく}できる→合格する：27949_goukakusuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{受験者|じゅけんしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ほんの→ほんの：22755_honno⟧{一握|ひとにぎ}りだ。
examples.english: Among the test takers, only a mere handful can pass that exam.

notes:
{一握|ひとにぎ}り literally means "one grip" — the amount you can hold in a fist. The figurative sense (a tiny minority) is more common in everyday usage.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {一握|ひとにぎ}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: a handful of people
- {一握|ひとにぎ}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧: a handful of companies
- ⟦ほんの→ほんの：22755_honno⟧{一握|ひとにぎ}り: a mere handful

RELATED QUANTITY WORDS:
- ひとつかみ: a grab, a handful (similar to {一握|ひとにぎ}り)
- ひとつまみ: a pinch (smaller amount)

WATCH OUT:
Do not confuse with ⟦おにぎり→おにぎり：04956_onigiri⟧ ({御握|おにぎ}り), which means rice ball.
